items.front: India's population and density (Census 2011)?
items.back: 121.09 crore; density 382/km²; decadal growth 17.7%.
items.examPoint: Population size — 121 crore; 2001-11 absolute increase (18.19 cr / 181 million)
items.source: notes

items.front: Sex ratio & child sex ratio (2011); state extremes?
items.back: Sex ratio 943 (Kerala 1084 high, Haryana 879 low); child sex ratio 919.
items.examPoint: Sex ratio 943 — trend, rural/urban, state extremes (Kerala/Haryana)
items.source: notes

items.front: India's literacy and urban share (2011)?
items.back: Literacy 74.04%; urban population 31.16% (rural 68.8%).
items.source: notes

items.front: Densest vs least-dense state (2011)?
items.back: Bihar densest (1106/km²); Arunachal Pradesh least dense.
items.source: notes

items.front: Four stages of demographic transition?
items.back: High stationary → early expanding → late expanding → low stationary (Notestein).
items.source: notes

items.front: What is the demographic dividend & India's window?
items.back: Bulge of working-age (15–59) population; India's window ~till 2055–56.
items.source: notes

items.front: Largest internal migration stream & main reasons (2011)?
items.back: Rural-to-rural largest; females mainly marriage, males mainly work.
items.source: notes

items.front: How many PVTGs and key criteria?
items.back: 75 PVTGs; pre-agri technology, low literacy, stagnant/declining small population.
items.examPoint: Tribes of India & AP; AP PVTGs (Chenchu, Konda Reddi, etc.)
items.source: notes

items.front: AP's largest ST and key PVTGs?
items.back: Yanadi largest ST; Chenchu, Konda Reddi, Konda Savara are PVTGs.
items.examPoint: AP tribes & agency areas — Yanadi (largest ST), Chenchu/Konda Reddi/Konda Savara PVTGs
items.source: notes

items.front: Rural settlement patterns?
items.back: Nucleated/compact, dispersed/scattered, hamleted, linear.
items.source: notes

items.front: Tribe–state traps: Karbi and Bonda?
items.back: Karbi = Assam (not HP); Bonda = Odisha (not TN); Limboo = Sikkim.
items.examPoint: Tribe–State mapping (all-India: Limboo/Sikkim, Dongaria Kondh/Odisha, Karbi/Assam, Bonda/Odisha)
items.source: notes

items.front: India's population rank in the world (2023)?
items.back: Most populous country, surpassing China (UN/UNFPA estimate).
items.examPoint: India — world's most populous country (UN estimate 2023)
items.source: notes

items.front: Census 2027 key features?
items.back: 16th census; first digital; caste enumeration; reference dates.
items.examPoint: Census 2027 — 16th census, first digital, caste enumeration, reference dates
items.source: notes

items.back: Sweden — The first modern census anywhere was held in Sweden in 1749.
